summary: Import-time remote binary dropper in package presented as analytics/telemetry SDK
details: On require of the package, index.js loads setup.js which reassembles a set of remote hostnames from split string fragments (Cloudflare Workers subdomains under workers.dev and hosts under dl.well1.site) and selects a platform-specific asset path (/pkg/package, /pkg/loader_mac, /pkg/package.exe). lib/telemetry.js issues an https.request to those hosts, base64-decodes the response chunks, writes the bytes to /var/tmp (or the Windows TEMP directory), chmods the file to 0755, and execFiles it. Node API names and host strings are constructed at runtime (os["plat"+"form"](), require("child_"+"process"), fs["chmod"+"Sync"], array-joined host fragments) to evade static matching. setup.js also builds an installFingerprint from os.hostname, os.userInfo().username, process.cwd, process.version, and pid and passes it to the same transport as installId, letting the operator track each victim. The fetched bytes are attacker-controlled, unpinned, and unverified, and execution fires on module load with no lifecycle script required.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
